mapper.sql:
id, object_id,
text NULL::text AS text ,
jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object( 'chunkId', metadata -> 'chunkId', 'documentId', metadata -> 'documentId', '_vectorRowId', 'row-' || id )) AS metadata
metadata '{}'::jsonb AS metadata

sql.if: AND ( LOWER(text) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), '%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(metadata ->> 'chunkId', '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), '%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(metadata ->> 'documentId', '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), '%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(metadata ->> 'sourceDocumentId', '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), '%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(metadata ->> 'headingPath', '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), '%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(metadata ->> 'section', '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), '%') )

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_ai_document_chunk(object_type, object_id, chunk_index, text, metadata, embedding, embedding_dimension) VALUES ( #{objectType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{objectId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{chunkIndex}, #{text,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CAST(#{metadata,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{embedding,typeHandler=studio.one.platform.ai.adapters.vector.mybatis.PgVectorTypeHandler}, #{embeddingDimension} ) ON CONFLICT (object_type, object_id, chunk_index) DO UPDATE SET text = EXCLUDED.text, metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata, embedding = EXCLUDED.embedding, embedding_dimension = EXCLUDED.embedding_dimension

INSERT INTO tb_ai_document_chunk(object_type, object_id, chunk_index, text, metadata, embedding, embedding_dimension) VALUES
( #{chunk.objectType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{chunk.objectId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{chunk.chunkIndex}, #{chunk.text,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CAST(#{chunk.metadata,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{chunk.embedding,typeHandler=studio.one.platform.ai.adapters.vector.mybatis.PgVectorTypeHandler}, #{chunk.embeddingDimension} )
ON CONFLICT (object_type, object_id, chunk_index) DO UPDATE SET text = EXCLUDED.text, metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata, embedding = EXCLUDED.embedding, embedding_dimension = EXCLUDED.embedding_dimension
mapper.select:
SELECT , AS distance FROM tb_ai_document_chunk
ORDER BY ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT , AS distance, ts_rank_cd(to_tsvector('simple', text || ' ' || COALESCE(metadata->>'keywordsText','')), plainto_tsquery(#{query,jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AS bm25, ( * #{vectorWeight}) - (COALESCE(ts_rank_cd(to_tsvector('simple', text || ' ' || COALESCE(metadata->>'keywordsText','')), plainto_tsquery(#{query,jdbcType=VARCHAR})), 0) * #{lexicalWeight}) AS hybrid FROM tb_ai_document_chunk
ORDER BY hybrid ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_ai_document_chunk WHERE object_type = #{objectType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND (CAST(#{objectId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS varchar) IS NULL OR object_id = CAST(#{objectId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS varchar))

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_ai_document_chunk WHERE object_type = #{objectType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND (CAST(#{objectId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS varchar) IS NULL OR object_id = CAST(#{objectId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS varchar))
